Du löst ein Single-Item Lot-Sizing-Problem mit Kapazitätsrestriktion über 25 Perioden. In jeder Periode kann produziert werden (mit fixen Setup-Kosten, falls produziert wird, plus variablen Produktionskosten pro Einheit), bis zur jeweiligen Kapazitätsgrenze. Nicht verkaufte Mengen werden mit Lagerkosten pro Einheit auf die Folgeperiode übertragen. Kein Anfangsbestand. Ziel: Minimiere die Gesamtkosten (Setup + Produktion + Lagerhaltung) über alle Perioden, sodass die Nachfrage jeder Periode exakt gedeckt wird.

import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 46, "setup_cost": 116, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "2": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 489, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "3": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 160, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "4": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 217, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "5": {"demand": 39, "setup_cost": 358, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "6": {"demand": 13, "setup_cost": 117, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "7": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 219, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "8": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 410, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "9": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 323, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "10": {"demand": 19, "setup_cost": 189, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "11": {"demand": 40, "setup_cost": 308, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "12": {"demand": 32, "setup_cost": 327, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "13": {"demand": 24, "setup_cost": 498, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "14": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 244, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "15": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 148, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "16": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 312, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "17": {"demand": 44, "setup_cost": 378, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "18": {"demand": 24, "setup_cost": 299, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "19": {"demand": 48, "setup_cost": 393, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "20": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 327, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "21": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 457, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "22": {"demand": 25, "setup_cost": 140, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "23": {"demand": 11, "setup_cost": 183, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "24": {"demand": 48, "setup_cost": 430, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "25": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 347, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 47, "2": 31, "3": 33, "4": 23, "5": 37, "6": 20, "7": 51, "8": 48,
    "9": 36, "10": 22, "11": 42, "12": 38, "13": 32, "14": 32, "15": 53,
    "16": 10, "17": 64, "18": 23, "19": 58, "20": 13, "21": 15, "22": 34,
    "23": 13, "24": 39, "25": 32
}

# Erstelle das Modell
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere Gesamtkosten
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfragebedingung
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbedingung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Lösen des Modells
model.optimize()

# Ausgabe der Ergebnisse
result = {
    "production": {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

import json
print(json.dumps(result))
